question: Which of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?

options.text: Bharat Ratna Atal Bihari Vajpayee Cricket Stadium - Lucknow

solution:
The correct answer is __**Arun Jaitley cricket stadium - Bengaluru.**____** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Arun Jaitley Stadium**

 
 
• Arun Jaitley Stadium is a cricket stadium located at** Bahadur Shah Zafar Marg, New Delhi.**
 
• It was **established in 1883** as the **Feroz Shah Kotla Stadium.**
 
• It is the **second oldest international cricket stadium** still functional in India.
 
• Since 2008 the stadium has been the home venue of the Delhi Capitals of the Indian Premier League.
 
• This stadium hosted ODI matches when India hosted the Cricket World Cup in **1987, 1996, and 2011.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Eden Garden**

 
 
• Eden Gardens is a cricket ground in Kolkata, India.
 
• It was established in 1864.
 
• It is the oldest and second-largest cricket stadium in India and the third-largest in the world.
 
• The stadium currently has a capacity of 66,000.
 
 
 
• **Narendra Modi cricket stadium**
 
 
• **​**The Narendra Modi Stadium is a cricket stadium situated in Ahmedabad, India.
 
• As of 2022, it is the largest stadium in the world.
 
• It has a seating capacity of 132,000 spectators.
